themes.name: Light
themes.hint: Dark text on a light background. The default for most products.

themes.name: Dark
themes.hint: Light text on a dark background. Feels modern and technical; easy on the eyes at night.

themes.name: Both
themes.hint: Light by default, with a dark version that follows the visitor's system setting.

density.name: Airy
density.hint: Lots of space around everything. Calm and premium; good for landing pages.

density.name: Balanced
density.hint: A comfortable middle ground that works for most pages.

density.name: Compact
density.hint: More information per screen. Good for dashboards and admin tools.

shapes.name: Sharp
shapes.hint: Square corners and crisp lines. Serious and precise.

shapes.name: Soft
shapes.hint: Slightly rounded corners and gentle shadows. Friendly but professional.

shapes.name: Rounded / pill
shapes.hint: Very round corners and pill buttons. Playful and approachable.

motion.name: None
motion.hint: Nothing moves. Fastest feeling and fully calm.

motion.name: Subtle
motion.hint: Small hover effects and gentle fades. Feels polished without being distracting.

motion.name: Expressive
motion.hint: Bouncy hovers and noticeable entrance animations. Fun and lively.

imagery.name: Photo placeholders
imagery.hint: Spaces for real photos you will add later. Feels human and concrete.

imagery.name: Abstract shapes / gradients
imagery.hint: Shapes and color instead of pictures. Modern and needs no assets.

imagery.name: None
imagery.hint: Type and layout only. Clean and fast.

tones.name: Friendly
tones.example: Shipping software should feel good. Let's make it easy.

tones.name: Playful
tones.example: Bugs hate us. Your users won't.

clash_rules.reason: Luxury looks rely on generous space; compact spacing makes them feel cramped and cheap.
Brutalist design depends on hard edges; pill shapes soften it into something generic.
Elegant serifs read as editorial/premium, which works against a dev-tool feel.
A long-form story needs room to breathe between chapters; compact spacing makes it a wall of content.
Pastels lose their softness on dark backgrounds and can look washed out.
Luxury usually means restrained color; highly saturated palettes read as mass-market.
Expressive motion draws attention to itself, which fights a minimal look.
